content.title: Sub-Area Planning: New Town
content.summary: The New Town Sub-Area Plan was approved by the City Council on June 4, 2023, serving as the guiding document for future development in the New Town Sub-Area, which includes areas along Wadsworth Boulevard and Bypass, as well as the Arvada Marketplace shopping center. This plan outlines the framework for development between the G Line tracks to the north and Interstate 70 to the south.
content.body:
The New Town Sub-Area Plan was approved by City Council on June 4, 2023. The plan will now act as the guiding document for new development in the New Town Sub-Area generally defined as the areas along Wadsworth Boulevard and Bypass between the G Line tracks on the north and Interstate 70 on the south. The Arvada Marketplace shopping center along 52nd Avenue is also included in this area.

[**Review the Approved New Town Sub-Area Plan**](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/munidocs/munidocs?nodeId=68bf47358423f)
